Table 12.15 Physical and Diagnostic Findings 
in Patients with Anorexia Nervosa
Skin & Extremities
• Cold hands & feet 
• Alopecia
• Dry skin 
• Acrocyanosis
• Lanugo 
• Dependent edema
Cardiovascular
• Bradycardia 
• Cardiac arrhythmias
• Hypotension 
• Electrocardiographic abnormalities
• Orthostatic hypotension
Gastrointestinal
• Salivary gland enlargement 
• Constipation
• Delayed gastric emptying
Plasma/Serum Values
• Elevated BUN & creatinine 
• Low T3
• Hyponatremia 
• Low-normal T4
• Hypokalemia 
• Low luteinizing hormone
• Hypercholesterolemia 
• Low follicle-stimulating hormone
• Hypoglycemia 
• Hypophosphatemia (during refeeding)
Bone
• Decreased bone mineral density
